# Guinness World Records

> > The official authority on record-breaking achievements, featuring iconic records, business marketing solutions, and TV format licensing.

Guinness World Records documents and verifies extraordinary human achievements, natural phenomena, and world superlatives. The organization also provides business marketing solutions including mass participation events, employee and student engagement strategies, and broadcast content formats through GWR Studios.

## Key Topics

- World Records
- Record-Breaking Achievements
- Business Marketing Solutions
- Mass Participation Events
- Employee Engagement
- Student Engagement
- TV Format Licensing
- Hall of Fame
- Case Studies
- Broadcast Content
- Community Engagement
- Record Verification
- Brand Activations
- Archive Footage

## Iconic Records & Hall of Fame

- [Burj Khalifa: The tallest building](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/records/icons/burj-khalifa-the-tallest-building-in-the-world): Burj Khalifa Dubai tallest building with multiple height records
- [Eliud Kipchoge: First marathon distance run under two hours](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/records/icons/eliud-kipchoge-first-marathon-distance-run-under-two-hours): Eliud Kipchoge's historic sub-two-hour marathon achievement in Berlin
- [Victor Vescovo: Deep-ocean explorations](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/records/icons/victor-vescovo-first-person-to-visit-the-ocean-deepest-points): Victor Vescovo's Challenger Deep exploration in Limiting Factor submarine
- [Jane Goodall: Longest-running wild-primate study](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/records/hall-of-fame/jane-goodall-longest-running-wild-primate-study): Jane Goodall's Gombe chimpanzee research longest-running primate study
- [Wim Hof: The Iceman](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/records/hall-of-fame/wim-hof-the-iceman): Wim Hof's extreme cold endurance records and breathing method
- [David Aguilar: First functional LEGO prosthetic arm](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/records/hall-of-fame/david-aguilar-first-functional-lego-prosthetic-arm): David Aguilar's LEGO prosthetic arm innovation for Poland Syndrome
- [Jyoti Amge: Shortest woman living](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/records/icons/jyoti-amge-the-shortest-woman-living): Jyoti Amge from India holds shortest woman living record
- [Dave Walsh: Heaviest wheelchair vehicle pull](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/records/icons/dave-walsh-heaviest-wheelchair-vehicle-pull): Dave Walsh's adaptive strongman wheelchair vehicle pull record in UK

## Business Marketing Solutions

- [Mass Participation Records](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/business-marketing-solutions/record-event-formats/mass-participation-records): Mass participation record events for community engagement and marketing
- [Student Engagement Strategies](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/business-marketing-solutions/student-engagement-strategies): Student engagement solutions for schools and universities via records
- [How to Engage Your Employees](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/business-marketing-solutions/employee-engagement-strategies/how-to): Employee engagement guide with motivational ideas and team-building tips

## Business Case Studies

- [Microsoft and Accenture](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/business-solutions/case-studies/microsoft-accenture-cloud-week-2020-developers-certificates-largest-online-video-chain-of-people-handing-over-an-object): Microsoft-Accenture largest online video chain record with 8,007 employees
- [Emirates Airline](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/business-solutions/case-studies/emirates-airline): Emirates 145 nationalities flight record for UAE Year of Tolerance
- [OZO Foods](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/business-solutions/case-studies/ozo): OZO Foods longest taco line record at Natural Products Expo West
- [Cappy](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/business-solutions/case-studies/cappy): Cappy Coca-Cola brand breakfast in bed mass participation record
